Listed salaries in current U.S. job postings

Compare listed pay by role and state using current job postings on Fortune Jobs AI. Each salary page requires at least eight open listings with usable pay in the same unit. Figures describe listed salary midpoints and the middle half of the postings, not a salary survey. Hourly and yearly rates are kept separate. Check the original listing for the full pay range and conditions.

How to use this search

This directory links to qualifying slices of the current catalogue. Each linked page states its own sample and scope.

Compare the pay unit and sample size before comparing locations. These are advertised amounts from current postings; they do not measure accepted offers, total compensation or the whole labor market.

Frequently asked questions

Where do these pay figures come from?

Only current open job postings in the Fortune Jobs AI catalogue are used; no external salary survey is combined with them.

Why are some roles or states missing?

A salary page requires at least eight current listings with usable pay in the same unit. We omit a page when that threshold is not met.

Are these guaranteed offers?

No. Listed pay can change and an offer may depend on the employer and candidate. Confirm the full range and terms in the original posting.
